_comment: Stage 14 Gate A - the canonical secret-detection corpus.
ONE source of truth for the secret CASES. Two runtimes enforce it:
Both read THIS file, so the two scanners cannot drift: conformance is CHECKED
rather than hand-maintained in two places.
Every value below is a DELIBERATE, OBVIOUSLY FAKE fixture. No real credential
belongs in this repository. The detectors must treat all of them as real.
id       stable identifier (used in failure output)
expect   'detect' (must be refused) | 'allow' (must NOT be a false positive)
category expected detector category for 'detect' cases
payload  the value handed to the scanner exactly as written

cases.label: an OpenAI project-scoped key (sk-proj- prefix variant)
an OpenAI classic key (bare sk- prefix, no fixed length assumed)
an OpenAI service-account key (sk-svcacct- prefix variant)
a PEM RSA private key block
cases.payload:
-----BEGIN RSA PRIVATE KEY-----
MIIEowIBAAKCAQEAx0000000000000000
-----END RSA PRIVATE KEY-----

cases.label: a PEM unencrypted private key block
a PEM EC private key block
cases.payload:
-----BEGIN EC PRIVATE KEY-----
MHcCAQEEI0000000000000000000000000
-----END EC PRIVATE KEY-----

cases.label: a PEM OpenSSH private key block
cases.payload:
-----BEGIN OPENSSH PRIVATE KEY-----
b3BlbnNzaC1rZXktdjEAAAAA00000000
-----END OPENSSH PRIVATE KEY-----

cases.label: an Authorization header carrying a bearer token
an Authorization header carrying HTTP Basic material
an Authorization header in PHP array form
a WordPress application password (the pre-existing 4x4 shape)
a CSS hex colour
a CSS rgb() function
a SHA-256 digest (the repository records digests everywhere)
a short hex digest
a UUID
a version string
a semver string with build metadata
a public URL
a public provider endpoint URL
ordinary source code
ordinary authorization-related prose (a documentation sentence)
cases.payload: the Authorization header is never rendered into an error

cases.label: a test NAME mentioning authorization
ordinary prose naming a credential, carrying no credential
cases.payload: the provider credential is read from the environment only

cases.label: ordinary prose naming a private key, carrying no key material
cases.payload: a private key never enters a run record

an ordinary run identifier
